subject: CS241
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English coverage is strong, with high-quality, highly-viewed videos for each topic. For Arabic, one topic ('Hardware-Software Codesign Trade-offs') had no eligible candidates passing both relevance and view count gates. Another topic ('Microcontroller Interrupts and Watchdog Timers') required using the low-view exception to select a suitable video. The remaining Arabic selections are solid introductory materials.

coverage.note: All candidates failed either the relevance gate (R<6) or the view count gate (<3000).
